fixtures.origin: Synthetic AIXM 5.1.1 documents hand-written for this repository on 2026-09-21 (adapter-expansion phase 4) against the pinned AIXM 5.1.1 XML Schema closure (EUROCONTROL & FAA, April 2016; GML 3.2.1); every designator is prefixed SYN, every UUID sits under the a1a40000- prefix, every position is a fictitious place and no file derives from any published aeronautical data set. Each `.xml` validates against the pinned XSD through an actual validator (`tests/test_cdm_aixm511_adapter.py::test_every_positive_fixture_validates_against_the_pinned_schema`, BLOCKED when the resource is absent); each `.parsed.json` twin is the codec's reading of the XML beside it, held to an independent ElementTree reading by `test_every_parsed_twin_corresponds_to_its_raw_fixture`; hashes are in `spec/aixm511_pin.json`.
